FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Grace Community Church, we are dedicated to providing spiritual guidance and support to our congregation through worship services, community outreach programs, and educational activities. Our operations include regular Sunday services, Bible study sessions, and youth programs, all conducted in a safe and welcoming environment. We prioritize the well-being of our members, particularly children, by implementing established child protection policies and background checks for all staff and volunteers. Additionally, we are committed to maintaining our facilities to meet local health and safety regulations, ensuring a secure space for worship and community activities.

Our church conducts annual community events that include clay modeling workshops, where participants dig for clay and shale in a designated area to create art pieces.
